part.text:
FLAG{46f74bda15224d0b987504acb3bf235f}

Recovered via Jinja SSTI: the `/error` endpoint renders `error_type` as a template path confined to `static/`. Since uploaded profile images land in `static/images/`, I uploaded a file containing a Jinja payload and included it with `error_type=../images/p4.html`, achieving RCE and reading `/flag`.
